issue_context.title: Elk M1 - TLS Host entry in configuration.yaml not valid
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Team,

When configuring the ELKM1 integration via the configuration.yaml file, the config fails to load if the host entry is set to elksv1_2://IP as per the documentation.

Here is my sample config:

``` YAML
elkm1:
  - host: elksv1_2://192.168.30.200
    username: MyUsername
    password: Super-Secret-Password
    auto_configure: true
    area:
      exclude: [2-8] 
```


When the configuration is loaded, the below error appears in the debug logs and the integration fails to add.

```
Invalid config for 'elkm1' at configuration.yaml, line 74: Invalid host URL 'elkm1->0', got {'host': 'elksv1_2://192.168.30.200', 'username': 'MyUsername', 'password': 'Super-Secret-Password', 'auto_configure': True, 'area': {'exclude': ['2-8']}}, please check the docs at https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/elkm1
```

The configuration of the integration with the TLS 1.2 config works fine via the GUI configuration. Looking at the config entry that it creates, the host entry is identical to what I entered via the configuration.yaml file.

```
{"created_at":"2025-03-08T12:02:20.850460+00:00","data":{"auto_configure":true,"host":"elksv1_2://192.168.30.200","password":"Super-Secret-Password","prefix":"","username":"MyUsername"},"disabled_by":null,"discovery_keys":{},"domain":"elkm1","entry_id":"01JNTT521J2TVFJA5JXHG3NDK7","minor_version":1,"modified_at":"2025-03-08T12:02:20.850466+00:00","options":{},"pref_disable_new_entities":false,"pref_disable_polling":false,"source":"user","subentries":[],"title":"ElkM1","unique_id":null,"version":1}

```

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2025.3.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

elkm1

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/elkm1/
